title: 亚德尼：金融与医疗保健或成AI应用大赢家
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I think when we look at the wild moves that we've seen today with the market that look like it was basically heading into an abyss and now most of the major indices in the green is a correction over.
segments.zh: 今天市场剧烈波动，看似要跌入深渊，现在主要指数多数收涨，调整可能结束。

segments.en: Well, it felt sort of like Monday combined with Friday.
segments.zh: 感觉像是周一和周五的结合体。

segments.en: As you said Friday last week was a debacle and it was very depressing to come to the weekend with what had happened.
segments.zh: 正如你所说，上周五表现糟糕，带着那样的结果进入周末令人沮丧。

segments.en: And then on Monday it basically reversed itself dramatically and here we kind of had another one of these U-turns.
segments.zh: 然后周一基本大幅逆转，这里又出现了一次这样的掉头。

segments.en: I think we're doing our best here to find a bottom and I think right around 6,900, 7,000 and we're finding support.
segments.zh: 我认为我们正在尽力寻找底部，大约在6900、7000点附近找到支撑。

segments.en: I think we're finding buyers, dip buyers at these kind of levels.
segments.zh: 我认为在这些水平上我们找到了买家，逢低买入者。

segments.en: Earnings remain outstanding and I think that's what's going to save this bull market.
segments.zh: 盈利依然出色，我认为这将拯救这轮牛市。

segments.en: Where's the leadership do you think is that going to come from to that resume being the tech stocks or at least some of those AI stocks?
segments.zh: 你认为领导力会来自哪里，是科技股还是至少一些AI股？

segments.en: Well, I think the known unknowns about the AI trade are going to remain with us for a while.
segments.zh: 我认为AI交易的已知未知数还会伴随我们一段时间。

segments.en: The big issue is are they actually ever going to make money and all the money that they're investing in the AI infrastructure.
segments.zh: 大问题是他们是否真的能赚钱，以及他们投入AI基础设施的所有资金。

segments.en: And that question isn't going to be answered readily.
segments.zh: 这个问题不会轻易得到答案。

segments.en: I think we are going to see that cloud computing revenues are going to be awesome.
segments.zh: 我认为我们会看到云计算收入非常亮眼。
